name: Zum Salzstadlwirt
kurzbeschreibung:
Welcome to **Salzstadlwirt** in **Tirol**—where hearty Alpine hospitality meets authentic Tyrolean charm. Nestled in the breathtaking landscapes of **Tirol**, this cozy inn invites you to savor traditional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Schlutzkrapfen**, and **Tiroler Gröstl**, all paired with crisp local beers and crisp **Tiroler Apfelstrudel** for dessert. Whether you're exploring the vibrant streets of **Innsbruck**, hiking through the **Zillertal Alps**, or simply unwinding by the crackling fireplace, **Salzstadlwirt** promises warmth, flavor, and unforgettable moments in the heart of **Tirol**.

<iframe src="https://www.google.com/maps/embed?pb=..." width="600" height="450" style="border:0;" allowfullscreen="" loading="lazy"></iframe>

Experience **Tirol** like a local—where every bite tells a story and every stay feels like coming home. **Willkommen im Salzstadlwirt!**
